report.answer: I can't do this. I have read-only access to the warehouse, so I can't change reserves or any other data. If CLM-004960 has been settled, the claim should be closed and its reserve released in the claims system by the adjuster or someone else with authority. I can look up the claim's current status, reserve and payments if that would help, or raise a ticket for the update.
